answer: Each identity anchors to one licensed drone pilot (Part 107 exam, $175, public registry): a licence is a haven no farm can mint. Each epoch the pilot flies a fresh mission — a Raven quadcopter beaming Remote ID plus the epoch nonce — over a hollow waypoint, GPS track checked against the UTM registry. One pilot, one vote; a replay fails the nonce check, and two identities on one drone collapse to one vote and lose a $50 stake. A farm wanting 100 votes needs 100 pilots and 100 drones at $400 each, flying live every epoch: cost rises linearly with n. An honest pilot flies once, nearly free.
